exposure: withholding nitrous oxide for labour analgesia
cohort: The study cohort consisted of women in labour in Australia during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020, where nitrous oxide was suspended on many birthing units.
finding: Withholding nitrous oxide for labour analgesia did not alter epidural rates but significantly increased opioid analgesia use, without changing caesarean section rates, post-partum blood loss, or neonatal APGAR scores.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates did not change as a result of withholding nitrous oxide for labour analgesia.
